key.name: style
key.description: "glass": translucent, softly blurred surfaces with rounded shapes. "classic": calmer frosted surfaces, more opaque, with tighter corners.

key.name: menu-bar-background
key.description: "clear": no background, only a faint shade at the top edge so the text stays readable. "tinted": an even translucent band. "solid": an opaque band. The colour of the band and its text follows the wallpaper under the bar. "auto" is clear with the glass style and tinted with the classic style (ticket #176).

key.name: ambient-sound
key.description: The sound parchaos-ambient plays (ticket #183). All of them are generated, not recorded.

key.name: ambient-volume
key.description: Its own level, under the system volume.

key.name: ambient-tone
key.description: 0 is warmer (darker), 1 is brighter.

key.name: ambient-minutes
key.description: 15 to 480 minutes; 0 keeps playing until stopped.

key.name: privacy-report
key.description: Note which apps used the microphone, camera, location or screen sharing, for Settings > Privacy (ticket #159). Kept for seven days in ~/.local/share/parchaos/privacy-log.json, readable only by the user. Turning it off deletes the file.

key.name: focus-mode
key.description: The focus mode in use (ticket #154): while one is on, only the apps listed for it in focus-mode-apps show banners (urgent ones, such as alarms, always do); the rest go straight to the notification list. Empty is no mode. Do Not Disturb is GNOME's own show-banners switch and silences every app.

key.name: focus-mode-apps
key.summary: Apps allowed to show banners in each focus mode
key.description: Desktop file ids, per mode.

key.name: focus-mode-dark
key.summary: Focus modes that switch to the dark appearance
key.description: The appearance goes back to what it was when the mode ends.

key.name: folder-colour
key.description: Colour of folders and the trash in the ParchaOS icon theme. parchaos-theme-sync picks the matching dark or light icon theme.

key.name: phone-link
key.description: Lets a paired phone reach this computer (GSConnect), on trusted networks only. parchaos-phone-guard starts and stops it.

key.name: phone-trusted-networks
key.summary: Networks where the phone connection may run
key.description: NetworkManager connection UUIDs the user trusts for the phone connection.

key.name: icon-style
key.description: How ParchaOS's app icons are drawn: standard, on dark plates, on glass plates with white glyphs, or in the accent colour (mono). parchaos-theme-sync picks the matching icon theme.

key.name: restore-session
key.summary: Reopen apps when logging back in
key.description: Reopen the apps that were open at the end of the last session and put their windows back where they were.

key.name: focus-schedule
key.description: Turn on Do Not Disturb every day between focus-start and focus-end. A Do Not Disturb the user turned on themselves is left alone.

key.name: focus-start
key.description: 24-hour local time. If later than focus-end, the period runs past midnight.

key.name: focus-end
key.description: 24-hour local time.

key.name: glass-effects
key.description: Turn on the optional glass-effects extension (panel menus, Quick Settings, notifications and the dock drawn as refractive glass) and show the standard Quick Settings panel in place of Parcha Controls. Off by default; it needs more graphics power.

key.name: glass-clarity
key.summary: How clear or tinted the glass is
key.description: 0 is Clear: very transparent glass with little tint. 1 is Tinted: darker, more opaque, more frosted glass. The default keeps the glass as designed. Applies to Parcha Controls, menus, the dock and the pickers (ticket #171).

key.name: controls-order
key.summary: Order of the tiles in Parcha Controls
key.description: Tile ids in the order they are placed (Edit Controls). Tiles not listed follow in the default order.

key.name: controls-hidden
key.description: Tile ids the user hid with Edit Controls.

key.name: controls-sizes
key.description: Sizes chosen with Edit Controls, as "id=COLUMNSxROWS" entries. Tiles not listed keep their default size.

key.name: learn-usage
key.summary: Learn from how the controls are used
key.description: Control Center keeps a small private record of which of its controls are used and when (control names, a fading score and a time; nothing else), stored only in the user's own data folder, to suggest the controls used most. Turning this off deletes the record.

key.name: launcher-order
key.description: The order of the launcher's apps and folders as the user arranged them: desktop IDs and "folder:ID". Items not listed follow in the default order.
